trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Rollback:** checkout-api was failing health checks on v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. I rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback completed and was verified.

2. **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.
